scope: Bounded Rust dispatch to independently confined serial OCR workers; synthetic functionality and isolation evidence, not full-pipeline throughput or filtering quality.

implementation.pool: Primary socket plus up to three distinct absolute additional sockets; per-worker reservation, global maximum, rotating selection, automatic permit release on error/cancellation. Legacy single-socket concurrency remains compatible.
implementation.isolation: One serial worker per systemd instance, separate dynamic UID and mount/network namespaces; original decoder/job limits retained.
implementation.framing: Single one-second deadline for header plus payload, independent one-second response-write limit; process supervision unchanged.
implementation.measurement: combined includes an image AND a PDF in every message and checks parts/pages/QR counts plus text length. Unknown original digests fail every profile. Both configured socket count and concurrency are reported.
implementation.deployment: Optional 1..4 instance installer; refresh active supported instances during upgrade; check previous config compatibility before rollback.

rust_full_semantic.scope: Runtime code tested before adding the extra global-limit/cancellation case.

rust_focused_semantic.scope: Includes overlap, saturation, free-worker selection, unavailable exchange, global limit and cancellation recovery; initializer style subsequently adjusted for Clippy only.

linux_instances.scope: Real unchanged worker and templates, no SMTP or models. Mount-namespace helpers drop groups/UID to check access; they do not prove inherited seccomp. Initial warmups checked status and backend; exact page/text/QR checks added to the follow-up CI test.
linux_instances.initial_harness_counter_correction: Initial output said pages_verified=6 but exact page/text/QR assertions covered only the four combined pages; this report distinguishes the two warmup requests.

cleanup.initial_cleanup_failure: Non-root removal failed on two root-owned Python cache files; exact remaining paths and terminated test units verified before privileged cleanup. Test was not rerun.

initial_failures.python3_12_system_openssl: 83 tests: four certificate-command errors and four Linux skips; corrected PATH uses OpenSSL3.6.4.

initial_failures.cleanup: Two root-owned Python caches prevented non-root removal; exact remainder and terminal units verified before privileged cleanup.
